text:
maria: FYI found a 404 when the onboarding CLI guide links to the emoji section: https://docs.redwood.inference/guides/cli#emoji -> 404. planning a tiny PR to fix the anchor and add a one-line guidance about emoji use in examples. who owns this guide? :wave:
jon: not an owner but can help grep for other broken fragments. can you paste the exact heading text on the page?
maria: heading reads 'Emoji guide' so the anchor should be `#emoji-guide` (not `#emoji`). my patch will: 1) fix the fragment, 2) add a 1-line guideline (e.g. use :sparkles: for new features, :warning: for cautions), 3) add a tiny linkcheck test. trivial change.
tara: I own that guide 

Thanks for catching it. small PRs are fine. open one and tag me, I'll review. if CI passes I'll merge quickly.
linkbot: task created docs:linkfix-511 "onboarding CLI anchor + emoji blurb" assigned to @tara, reported by @maria
maria: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/845 - includes a unit linkcheck and the one-liner; pinging for review.
jon: skimmed diff  anchor change LGTM; one nit on punctuation in the new sentence.
tara: I'll resolve the punctuation nit and merge once CI is green. thanks, @maria :thumbsup:
maria: thanks all! I'll run a quick repo-wide grep for `#emoji` occurrences and post if I find other bad fragments.
jon: nice. if you want I can run the grep across the i18n folders too, in case translated pages have the wrong fragments.
maria: appreciate it, please do. I'll hold off additional PRs until we know scope.
